									'interestForElement'
							);

			};

			const supportResults = {};

			Object.entries(supportChecks).forEach(([apiName, check]) => {
					const isSupported = check();
					supportResults[apiName] = isSupported;

					document.documentElement.classList.add(
							isSupported
									? `supports-${apiName}`
									: `no-${apiName}`
					);

			if (!supportResults.interestInvokers || !supportResults.anchorPositioning) {

    <script>
        function listenMediaPrefersColorChangeGlobal(){
            if (window.prefersDarkScheme.matches) {
                window.htmlElement.dataset.colorScheme = 'dark';
								window.postMessage({ __dianomiTheme: { theme: 'dark' } });
            } else {
                window.htmlElement.dataset.colorScheme = 'light';
								window.postMessage({ __dianomiTheme: { theme: 'light' } });
            }
        }

        window.suggestedColorScheme = localStorage.getItem('colorScheme');
        window.htmlElement = document.querySelector('html');
        window.prefersDarkScheme = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');

        if (!window.suggestedColorScheme || window.suggestedColorScheme == 'auto') {
            localStorage.setItem('colorScheme', 'auto');

            if (window.prefersDarkScheme.matches) {
                window.htmlElement.dataset.colorScheme = 'dark';
								window.postMessage({ __dianomiTheme: { theme: 'dark' } });
            } else {
                window.htmlElement.dataset.colorScheme = 'light';
								window.postMessage({ __dianomiTheme: { theme: 'light' } });
            }

            window.prefersDarkScheme.addEventListener('change', listenMediaPrefersColorChangeGlobal);
        } else {
            window.htmlElement.dataset.colorScheme = window.suggestedColorScheme;
        }
    </script>

    <script type="module">
        let userEmail = localStorage.getItem('userEmail');
        let userId = localStorage.getItem('userId');
        let userSignUpDate = localStorage.getItem('userSignUpDate');

        if (userEmail && userId && userSignUpDate) {
            gtmDataLayer.push({
                email: userEmail,
                signup_date: userSignUpDate,
                userId: userId,
            });
        } else {
            let fetchUrl = '/layout-auth-data/';
            fetch(fetchUrl)
            .then(response => {
            if (response.ok) {
                return response.text();
            } else {
                throw new Error('Something went wrong');
            }
            })
            .then(html => {
                const parser = new DOMParser();
                const doc = parser.parseFromString(html, "text/html");
                userEmail = doc.querySelector('input[name="gtm_user_email"]');
                userSignUpDate = doc.querySelector('input[name="gtm_user_signup_date"]');
                userId = doc.querySelector('input[name="gtm_user_id"]');

                if (userEmail && userSignUpDate && userId) {
                    gtmDataLayer.push({
                        email: userEmail.value,
                        signup_date: userSignUpDate.value,
                        userId: userId.value,
                    });

                    localStorage.setItem('userEmail', userEmail.value);
                    localStorage.setItem('userSignUpDate', userSignUpDate.value);
                    localStorage.setItem('userId', userId.value);

                } else {
                    console.log('No user authorised');
                }
            })
            .catch(error => {
            console.log(error);
            })
        }
    </script>

							return (

					interestInvokers: () => {
							return Object.hasOwn(
									HTMLButtonElement.prototype,
									'interestForElement'
							);
					}
			};

			const supportResults = {};

			Object.entries(supportChecks).forEach(([apiName, check]) => {
					const isSupported = check();
					supportResults[apiName] = isSupported;

					document.documentElement.classList.add(
							isSupported
									? `supports-${apiName}`
									: `no-${apiName}`
					);

        function listenMediaPrefersColorChangeGlobal(){
            if (window.prefersDarkScheme.matches) {
                window.htmlElement.dataset.colorScheme = 'dark';
								window.postMessage({ __dianomiTheme: { theme: 'dark' } });
            } else {
                window.htmlElement.dataset.colorScheme = 'light';
								window.postMessage({ __dianomiTheme: { theme: 'light' } });
            }
        }

        window.suggestedColorScheme = localStorage.getItem('colorScheme');
        window.htmlElement = document.querySelector('html');
        window.prefersDarkScheme = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');

        if (!window.suggestedColorScheme || window.suggestedColorScheme == 'auto') {
            localStorage.setItem('colorScheme', 'auto');

            if (window.prefersDarkScheme.matches) {
                window.htmlElement.dataset.colorScheme = 'dark';
								window.postMessage({ __dianomiTheme: { theme: 'dark' } });
            } else {
                window.htmlElement.dataset.colorScheme = 'light';
								window.postMessage({ __dianomiTheme: { theme: 'light' } });
            }

            window.prefersDarkScheme.addEventListener('change', listenMediaPrefersColorChangeGlobal);
        } else {
            window.htmlElement.dataset.colorScheme = window.suggestedColorScheme;
        }
    </script>

    <script type="module">
        let userEmail = localStorage.getItem('userEmail');
        let userId = localStorage.getItem('userId');
        let userSignUpDate = localStorage.getItem('userSignUpDate');

        if (userEmail && userId && userSignUpDate) {
            gtmDataLayer.push({
                email: userEmail,
                signup_date: userSignUpDate,
                userId: userId,
            });
        } else {
            let fetchUrl = '/layout-auth-data/';
            fetch(fetchUrl)
            .then(response => {
            if (response.ok) {
                return response.text();
            } else {
                throw new Error('Something went wrong');
            }
            })
            .then(html => {
                const parser = new DOMParser();
                const doc = parser.parseFromString(html, "text/html");
                userEmail = doc.querySelector('input[name="gtm_user_email"]');
                userSignUpDate = doc.querySelector('input[name="gtm_user_signup_date"]');
                userId = doc.querySelector('input[name="gtm_user_id"]');

                if (userEmail && userSignUpDate && userId) {
                    gtmDataLayer.push({
                        email: userEmail.value,
                        signup_date: userSignUpDate.value,
                        userId: userId.value,
                    });

                    localStorage.setItem('userEmail', userEmail.value);
                    localStorage.setItem('userSignUpDate', userSignUpDate.value);
                    localStorage.setItem('userId', userId.value);

                } else {
                    console.log('No user authorised');
                }
            })
            .catch(error => {
            console.log(error);
            })
        }
    </script>
